description: This file defines the NextWordsContainer class, which manages a collection of NextWord objects associated with a specific word, providing methods for updating usage and retrieving suggestions.

classes.name: NextWordsContainer
classes.description: A container class for managing next word suggestions related to a specific word, including updating usage and sorting suggestions.

methods.name: NextWordsContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a word and a list of next words, setting their frequency.

methods.name: markWordAsUsed
methods.description: Marks a given word as used, updating its internal state or adding it if not present.

methods.name: getNextWordSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of next word suggestions based on usage.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the container and its next words.
